about_short_description.short_description: Waterplan is a SaaS platform for companies to manage water availability in their facilities and supply chain.

product.name: Waterplan Platform
product.description: A SaaS platform that centralizes and standardizes high-quality local water risk data to help companies measure, report, and respond to water risks across their operations and supply chains.

product.name: Water Risk Measurement
product.description: A service within the platform that provides granular, site-specific water risk data by integrating multiple data sources and AI to assess physical, regulatory, reputational, and infrastructure water risks.

product.name: Water Risk Reporting
product.description: A reporting tool that automates and standardizes water risk and stewardship disclosures, aligning data with major frameworks like CDP, ESRS, GRI, and TCFD to streamline internal and external reporting.

identifier.value: Water Risk Response and Stewardship Management

product.name: Water Risk Response and Stewardship Management
product.description: A service that helps companies develop and implement water risk mitigation strategies, track progress toward water targets, and identify partners and projects to support water security goals.
